name: Question 1
problem:
Consider the following initial value problem:

$$
{y}^{′}=\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+1)-2xy,\,y(0)=-2
$$

The trapezoidal method is applied with step size $Δx=3.$ Find the general formula for the new $y$ value, ${y}_{\text{new}},$ in terms of the current values $x$ and $y,$ and the new value ${x}_{\text{new}}.$
worked_solution:
For an initial value problem

$$
{y}^{′}=f(x,y),\,y(a)=c,
$$

the trapezoidal method with step size $Δx$ is given by

$$
Δy=\frac{1}{2}({y}^{′}+{y}_{\text{new}}^{′})\cdot Δx,
$$

with ${y}_{\text{new}}^{′}=f({x}_{\text{new}},{y}_{\text{new}})$ evaluated at the next $x$ and $y$ values.

In this example, $Δy$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & =\frac{1}{2}({y}^{′}+{y}_{\text{new}}^{′})\cdot Δx \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+1)-2xy+(\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}_{\text{new}}+1)-2{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}}))\cdot 3 \\  & =\frac{3}{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+1)+\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}_{\text{new}}+1)-2xy)-3{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}}.\end{aligned}
$$

We substitute this into ${y}_{\text{new}}=y+Δy:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}_{\text{new}} & =y+Δy \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =y+\frac{3}{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+1)+\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}_{\text{new}}+1)-2xy)-3{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}} \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =\frac{3}{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+1)+\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}_{\text{new}}+1)-2xy+\frac{2}{3}y)-3{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we solve for the general formula for ${y}_{\text{new}}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}_{\text{new}}+3{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}} & =\frac{3}{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+1)+\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}_{\text{new}}+1)-2xy+\frac{2}{3}y) \\ {y}_{\text{new}}(1+3{x}_{\text{new}}) & =\frac{3}{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+1)+\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}_{\text{new}}+1)-2xy+\frac{2}{3}y) \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =\frac{3\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+1)+3\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}_{\text{new}}+1)-6xy+2y}{2+6{x}_{\text{new}}}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 1
?

Consider the following initial value problem: y′=ln⁡(x+1)−2xy,y(0)=−2 The trapezoidal method is applied with step size Δx=3. Find the general formula for the new y value, ynew, in terms of the current values x and y, and the new value xnew.

a
ynew=ln⁡(x+1)+3ln⁡(xnew+1)−6xy+2y2+6xnew
b
ynew=3ln⁡(x+1)+3ln⁡(xnew+1)−6xy+2y2+6xnew
c
ynew=3ln⁡(x+1)+3ln⁡(xnew+1)−4xy+2y2+6xnew
d
ynew=3ln⁡(x+1)+3ln⁡(xnew+1)−6xy+2y1+6xnew
e
ynew=3ln⁡(x+1)+3ln⁡(xnew+1)−6xy+y2+6xnew
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

For an initial value problem y′=f(x,y),y(a)=c, the trapezoidal method with step size Δx is given by Δy=12(y′+ynew′)⋅Δx, with ynew′=f(xnew,ynew) evaluated at the next x and y values.

In this example, Δy is given by

Δy=12(y′+ynew′)⋅Δx=12(ln⁡(x+1)−2xy+(ln⁡(xnew+1)−2xnewynew))⋅3=32(ln⁡(x+1)+ln⁡(xnew+1)−2xy)−3xnewynew.

We substitute this into ynew=y+Δy:

ynew=y+Δyynew=y+32(ln⁡(x+1)+ln⁡(xnew+1)−2xy)−3xnewynewynew=32(ln⁡(x+1)+ln⁡(xnew+1)−2xy+23y)−3xnewynew

Finally, we solve for the general formula for ynew:

ynew+3xnewynew=32(ln⁡(x+1)+ln⁡(xnew+1)−2xy+23y)ynew(1+3xnew)=32(ln⁡(x+1)+ln⁡(xnew+1)−2xy+23y)ynew=3ln⁡(x+1)+3ln⁡(xnew+1)−6xy+2y2+6xnew
